# Ghost Writer Bundle

A legacy OKF v0.1 knowledge bundle produced by ghost-writer/0.3.

## Concepts

- [OKF Bundle](./concepts/okf-bundle.md) — A portable knowledge directory assembled by ghost-writer, where every page carries legacy v0.1 provenance.
- [Ghost Canonicalization](./concepts/ghost-canonicalization.md) — The ghost-writer rule that every v0.1 header block emits its keys in one fixed order so diffs stay readable.

## Entities

- [Ghost Runner](./entities/ghost-runner.md) — The background process in ghost-writer that walks a bundle directory and re-emits pages after a schema change.

## Skills

- [Ghost Sync Flow](./skills/ghost-sync-flow.md) — The five-step ghost-writer procedure for syncing a legacy bundle after a schema revision.

## References

- [Ghost Spec 0.1](./references/ghost-spec-0.1.md) — The frozen v0.1 header-block specification that ghost-writer producers emitted between 2025 and 2026.

## Synthesis

- [Ghost Synthesis](./synthesis/ghost-synthesis.md) — What ghost-writer's v0.1 corpus implies for any consumer upgrading legacy header blocks to v0.2.
